message.content:
Based on my search, **Procol Harum** was the first to sing "A Whiter Shade of Pale." The song was released as their debut single on **May 12, 1967**, with **Gary Brooker** as the lead vocalist. The recording was made at Olympic Sound Studios in London with Brooker on vocals and piano, Matthew Fisher on Hammond organ, Ray Royer on guitar, David Knights on bass, and session drummer Bill Eyden. The band reportedly laid it down in just two or three takes with no overdubs.

The song became a worldwide hit, topping the UK charts for six weeks and defining the "Summer of Love" era. It remains one of the most iconic songs of the 1960s and has been covered by over 1,000 artists since its original release.
